canh.thoai: I have been waiting for this moment my whole life. Today, everything changes.
canh.ghi_chu: Nhan vat nhin thang vao ong kinh, camera nhich toi rat cham, anh sang am.
Canh rong khong thoai: may troi qua thanh pho luc hoang hon, camera lia sang phai.

canh.thoai: So this is where the road ends. And where the real story finally begins.
canh.ghi_chu: Nhan vat quay nguoi buoc di, gio thoi nhe qua toc, camera giu nguyen.
